title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1511: Eighth level (1)

section.p: Su Yu started writing down the names, cultivation levels, and specialties of some experts in his book. Before long, the immortal page was full.
“It is still lacking.”

The immortal page was full, but it was still lacking something. It lacked Skysoars, those below Skysoars, and Invincibles. As for the divines, some of them were still kept alive in his book. As for the devils, he wondered if all of them were dead. Was Mo Duona dead as well? Su Yu was unsure. If Mo Duona could survive, it could only mean that he was blessed by luck.

There was also a possibility that Mo Duona was not staying with Blood Fire Devil King. After all, the two weren’t exactly allies. Su Yu did not feel like Mo Duona would be willing to hide in a secret realm or heaven weapon of Blood Fire Devil King. He had been prepared to enter the eighth level earlier. Since he was missing, it was likely that he had entered the eighth level alone.
He had promised to help Su Yu with the skylotus, but the final battle had grown too intense. Even someone like Great Qin King had appeared. Perhaps that guy had decided to escape then.
“There’s also the Heaven Department head. Is he dead?”
It was hard to say. Su Yu didn’t know what to feel about the department head. He didn’t have any friendship with the department head. He wouldn’t be saddened by the department head’s death.

But the department head had driven himself crazy. Thus, Su Yu felt a slight regret about that. After reaching such a cultivation level, a conflict had erupted between his three bodies. As a ninth-degree Eternal, he could have turned the battle around easily regardless of who he decided to help.
Alas, he had decided to fight himself instead. Otherwise, he could have snatched the skylotus for himself.
“Three Body Method…”

Su Yu muttered to himself as he shut his book. The weaknesses of the Three Body Method were obvious. But that seemed to be the sole path available for everyone. Lan Tian and Wan Tiansheng were the perfect examples of this. Walking a different path was the same as walking a dead end.
Just then, Xing Yue’s voice rang out, “Su Yu, I am leaving.”
Su Yu looked at her and smiled, “Don’t be in a rush, Lord. If the Source Return Blade is gone, you can leave anytime. If the blade is still around, it will be dangerous for you to leave now.”
He continued, “This is a rare chance. There is no rush. We can also leave through the first level instead of the death tunnel. Don’t worry. I’ll think of a proper solution.”
There were alternatives to leave the mansion. Su Yu was also thinking of a safe way to leave the mansion.
He said, “I intend to take a look at the eighth level. Maybe there are survivors in there. Teacher Liu and the others are still there as well. I need to go and see if they need any help.”
He had to enter the eighth level. Liu Wenyan and Hong Tan were there. Why were two weak Sunmoons running around everywhere? Were they not afraid of death?
After some hesitation, Yun Chen asked, “Are you really entering the eighth level?”
“Yes.” Su Yu smiled, “Thus, I’ll be troubling you for the people here.”
He looked at Lan Tian and asked, “Senior Lan Tian, what is your actual purpose here? Don’t tell me you’re only here for fun.”
“I don’t understand what you’re saying.”
Su Yu smiled again and said, “I doubt you need most of the treasures here.”
“The nine-leaf skylotus is very useful.”
“If you don’t wish to tell me, so be it.”

Lan Tian laughed and said, “Fine, fine. I’m here for a reason. I wish to enter the eighth level as well. That was why Tiansheng sent me here. But I don’t have much hope that I’ll succeed. Tiansheng knows about an ancient expert who once resided here. He wants me to look for a clear path for the both of us.”
“Who?”
“Culture King.”
“I don’t know that person.”
That was a name Su Yu had never heard about.

Lan Tian was unfamiliar with that name as well. he said, “I heard that was a big shot. But I don’t know too much about him. I only know that the path of all cultural researchers will be stuck at the Sunmoon Realm. Tiansheng wants me to look for a way forward. We have no choice since the way forward is too hard to find.”

He sighed. Yes. The way forward wouldn’t be easy. Was Wan Tiansheng strong? Yes. Very strong. Even without affirming his dao, he was already as strong as a fourth-degree Eternal. That was why he could kill Invincibles. But that was all. He was stuck.
For Wan Tiansheng, that was far from enough. At present, he was only comparable to Xia Longwu in strength. But Xia Longwu was still growing. Meanwhile, there was no way forward for Wan Tiansheng.
“Culture King.” Su Yu asked, “Would Culture King leave a clear path behind? Did the principal tell you anything specific?”

“No. He doesn’t know much either. But he did run the Great Xia Cultural Research Academy for many years. He studied in the Knowledge Seeking Realm before as well. He had conversed with many experts about the great dao. He must have judged that the inheritance of our multiple character faction originated from Culture King.”
“Wait.” Su Yu looked at Lan Tian with surprise and asked, “What do you mean our multiple character faction? Senior Lan Tian, you’re from the transformation faction.”

Lan Tian argued nonchalantly, “Multiple character faction. As long as I have more than ten characters, I am a multiple character cultivator as well. During my youth, I formed my character technique. I was simply too lazy to learn more and focused on transformation instead.”
Yun Chen sighed and said, “You are very talented. What a pity…”
Lan Tian disagreed, “There’s nothing pitiful about me. I like my current state.”

Yun Chen said nothing else. He was Wan Tiansheng’s senior brother in name and teacher in practice. In terms of seniority, he was the same as Lan Tian, but in practice, he was a generation above Lan Tian.
Lan Tian smiled and asked, “Little Su Yu, let’s go to the eighth level together. As for these people, it’s safer for them to stay here.”
Su Yu asked, “Do you have a way to go up?”
“Yes.” Lan Tian flashed a sweet smile, “There is nowhere I can’t go…”
Su Yu shivered. He said, “Senior, you kept yelling that you had been wronged earlier…”
Lan Tian said grudgingly, “Didn’t you say that it was your friend? You should know the truth well, then.”
Sure enough, Lan Tian knew a little about Old Zhou as well.

Su Yu nodded and said, “Senior, your cloning technique is impressive. I could have stayed silent and that person might still decide to appear after you suffered more. Try not to provoke that person if possible. He’s too dangerous.”
“I know. Can’t you see that I’m not feeling wronged anymore?”

As Lan Tian said that, he had the expression of someone pretending to look happy. He was quite terrified of Old Zhou as well. Since all their enemies were dead, there was no need for him to keep feeling wronged lest he provoke Old Zhou again.

Both Lan Tian and Su Yu knew full well that Old Zhou was merely a vengeful soul in the Luminous Domain Mansion. It would be wise to leave that guy alone as someone like that lacked the ability to determine who his friend was.

Su Yu turned to look at the others who were still cultivating in the bathtub. After thinking about it, he took a storage ring out. The ring was filled with riversand, solidwater pearls, and some other treasures.

He handed the ring to Yun Chen and said, “Senior, please pass this over to my teacher. If possible, find a way to leave. It might be dangerous to leave through the regular tunnels, but that’s still better than leaving with me.”

After a short pause, he said, “If you do leave at a different time than me, tell them that I did everything here. Remind the others to not say anything about Great Qin King. Just blame everything on my collusion with the death spirits.”

Su Yu narrowed his eyes and continued, “I already reminded my backers in advance. I have nothing to fear. If the myriad races wish to provoke me, they are free to try. Great Qin King should try to do less in his current situation.”

He looked at Bai Feng and the others again before saying, “I might leave through the Death Realm. Just blame everything on me. It doesn’t matter. If you have to, you can blame Senior Lan Tian as well…”
Lan Tian complained, “I’m too weak. Nobody will buy that.”
“They will. After all, you’re unkillable.”
Yun Chen hesitated slightly and said, “The Death Realm is very dangerous. You might…have a decent relationship with some death spirits, but that won’t change anything.”
Su Yu said, “It’s fine. Someone skilled will always be braver. I dared to walk the Starfall Mountain as a mere Mental Tempering Stage cultivator. At my current level, a mere Death Realm is nothing.”
“I can protect you during your journey…”
“It’s fine.” Su Yu said, “You’re too strong. Your life force will be too conspicuous there. This path is only suitable for me alone. Nobody else.”
“Then…”

Su Yu did not intend to say more. He walked straight out of the realm barrier. The smiling Lan Tian and cold Xing Yue followed behind him. Behind, Yun Chen sighed as he glanced at Bai Feng and the storage ring Su Yu left him.
The multiple character faction had brought nothing but disaster to Su Yu. However, Su Yu had never given up on the faction.
